user.title: Hisense E7N Pro
user.description: The TV must be on. 爱家 pairing asks to turn Bluetooth on — enable Bluetooth on the Home Assistant host and fill the TV BLE address. MQTT 36669 is optional status; keys go over BLE.

data_description.host: IPv4 of the E7N Pro. Give it a DHCP reservation.
data_description.power_on_button: Home Assistant button / switch / script that physically turns the TV on (IR blaster key, smart plug, helper button). Turn-on calls button.press (or switch.turn_on). MQTT KEY_POWER cannot start a dead TV.
data_description.mac: Wi-Fi MAC. Used for Wake-on-LAN if no power-on button is set.
data_description.ble_address: Same prompt as 爱家: turn Bluetooth on, then enter the TV BLE MAC. Keys are sent as Hisense BLE HID reports.
data_description.auth_mode: auto tries modern VIDAA credentials first, then legacy static login.
data_description.client_cert: Leave empty to use a generated stand-in cert. If MQTT rc=5, extract the VIDAA/爱家 client cert (see docs).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the TV MQTT port (default 36669). Confirm the TV is fully on (not standby), the IP is the TV's LAN address, Home Assistant is on the same network, and phone remote / network control is enabled.
error.timeout: The TV accepted TCP on 36669 but did not complete MQTT. Wait until the TV has finished booting, then try again.
error.tls_failed: Reached port 36669 but the TLS handshake failed. The integration now uses legacy ciphers and the 爱家 client certificate automatically — retry after a TV reboot. If it still fails, the TV may be serving plain MQTT; keep auth mode on auto.
error.not_authorized: MQTT connected but the TV rejected the login (rc=5). Keep auth mode on auto, set the TV clock/timezone correctly, and retry. Newer VIDAA firmware needs dynamic credentials; older firmware uses hisenseservice.
error.cannot_connect_ble: Could not pair over Bluetooth. Enable Bluetooth on the Home Assistant machine (爱家 shows the same prompt) and confirm the TV BLE address.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the TV.

data_description.power_on_button: Entity pressed when the TV is off. Aijia cannot power the TV on by itself.
data_description.ble_address: Enable Bluetooth on the Home Assistant host and enter the TV BLE MAC.

error.cannot_connect_ble: Invalid or unreachable TV Bluetooth address. Enable Bluetooth on the Home Assistant host and retry.

key.name: Key
key.description: Wire name (KEY_HOME) or alias (home, ok, mute).
